title: Treaty of Dordrecht
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Dordrecht", at revision 1346903095, opens: "The Treaty of Dordrecht was signed on 14 February 1489 between Maximilian I, King of the Germans and King Henry VII of England. Based on the terms of the treaty, both parties agree to establish an alliance in order to help the Duchy of Brittany against an attack by the Kingdom of France." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7837037, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1489 treaty between the Holy Roman Empire and England". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
